selection: Previous eight IDs plus 12 SHA256-ranked new training IDs per domain; no outcome-based selection.

config_semantics.spork: Full reasoning SPORK D1/D2/D3; no early successor
config_semantics.raw: Full early successor; child up to five prediction attempts; child D3 off
config_semantics.raw_no_probe: Same early successor, zero child predictions; formal child tool execution retained
config_semantics.raw_one_probe: Same early successor, at most one child prediction; no child D2 retry

actor_failure_policy: Discard malformed speculative child; retry once on the canonical state with ordinary SPORK. A malformed canonical Actor completion is a recorded task failure, not a batch abort in expanded evaluation. Infrastructure/integrity failures remain fatal. No malformed text is delivered as a reply.
model_choice: Keep the verified 9B/v4 eager runtime for within-model expansion; Qwen3-32B is a later cross-model/architecture study.
quality: Native tau2 orchestration and ALL/strict_replay scoring. Local 9B user and local 9B NL judge, not the published simulator or judge setup.
measurement: Fresh prefix cache per trial; one discarded token from policy/tools plus the same fixed synthetic user message outside timing. Warmup never enters the real conversation. Interaction includes user calls; Agent pipeline equals interaction minus full measured user-generation calls. Scoring follows timing; only exact judge inputs reuse sealed judgments.
usercheck: Two initial-user generations on airline:2 with the same frozen input and seed. Require natural completion, mode-consistent nonempty reply and exact repeatability before Actor runs. This does not establish full simulator fidelity.
go_no_go: Pass usercheck first. Both domain preflight tasks must finish naturally with continued user interaction, exact trajectories, native scoring, clean D3, and exercised successor adoption before expanded runs.
scope: 32 training tasks (16 airline,16 retail); report previous8 and new24 separately. Actor is greedy with full reasoning; auxiliary user uses native non-thinking sampling. Seed42 repeats test reproducibility, not independent policy samples. No holdout or official leaderboard claim.
